name: Threat hunt hypotheses
description: Turns threat intelligence into a table of attack procedures framed as hunt hypotheses, with search patterns, log sources and Event IDs, plus prioritization notes. Use it to build a hunt backlog the team can execute in the SIEM or EDR.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Source material
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Paste the report(s), article text or analyst notes to analyse. Leave empty to let the agent collect from your connected integrations.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Product or service
manual_trigger_parameters.description: The intelligence product you deliver to the stakeholder teams.

name: Hunt lead extraction and prioritization
description: Breaks a report into a ranked list of candidate hunt leads (observable behaviors or artifacts) with ATT&CK mapping, relevance, priority, confidence and citations, without writing queries or hypotheses. Use it first, to decide which leads are worth scoping.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Source material
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Paste the report(s), article text or analyst notes to analyse. Leave empty to let the agent collect from your connected integrations.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Product or service
manual_trigger_parameters.description: The intelligence product you deliver to the stakeholder teams.

name: Hunt lead feasibility and coverage assessment
description: Assesses each hunt lead against your logging, controls, existing detections and analyst capacity, and recommends hunt now, defer, close gap first or convert to detection. Use it after lead extraction, before committing analyst time.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Hunt leads or source material
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Paste the hunt lead list (for example the output of the Hunt lead extraction assignment) or the report to analyse. Leave empty to let the agent collect from your connected integrations.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Stack summary
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Your logging sources, detection tooling, existing detections and key controls. Leave empty to use the Security stack line of the agent's Organization context.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Analyst capacity
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Available hunting resource, e.g. '2 hunters, 20 hours per week'. Leave empty to get effort estimates only.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Read SIEM inventory
manual_trigger_parameters.description: When on, the agent reads (never changes) data connectors, indexes and detection rules from your connected SIEM to complement the stack summary.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Product or service
manual_trigger_parameters.description: The intelligence product you deliver to the stakeholder teams.
manual_trigger_parameters.default: hunt lead feasibility and coverage assessment

name: Threat hunt hypotheses package
description: Converts a validated ATT&CK mapping into hunt hypotheses with patterns to look for and log sources or Event IDs, plus a prioritization note on what matters most and which data sources may be missing. Use it to hand a ready-to-run package to the hunting team.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Validated ATT&CK mapping
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Paste the validated ATT&CK mapping (procedures and technique IDs) to convert. Leave empty to let the agent assemble a mapping from your connected integrations.
